---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to Scope.
---

## Problem or use case

Describe the benchmarking workflow you want to improve, such as configuring tasks, running agents, evaluating output, or comparing results. What is difficult or missing in Scope today?

## Proposed change

Describe the improvement, the affected Scope area (CLI, Portal, API, workers, Judge, or reports), and how it would help your workflow. For user-facing changes, describe the CLI and Portal experience where relevant.

## Alternatives

What existing Scope options or workarounds have you tried or considered, and why are they insufficient?

## Additional context

Add relevant example tasks, agent/model combinations, evaluation criteria, or sample results, along with links or screenshots. Redact secrets and sensitive benchmark data.
